I am a quantitative researcher interested in **climate risk, environmental data science, systems modelling, and quantitative approaches to climate adaptation and mitigation planning**.

I completed the Integrated BS–MS programme at IISER Pune, with research spanning high-resolution climate reanalysis, nonlinear heat-stress metrics, statistical trend analysis, network methods, and agent-based modelling.

My current climate research asks a recurring methodological question: **how much do the conclusions of environmental analysis depend on the way we define, aggregate, and operationalise the quantities we measure?** I am increasingly interested in carrying that perspective into systems models that connect physical hazards and exposure with interventions, resources, behaviour, infrastructure, and policy choices.

For research correspondence: [vatsal.maurya@alumni.iiserpune.ac.in](mailto:vatsal.maurya@alumni.iiserpune.ac.in).
